RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 20

Raising bias based solely on the panel's gender composition is unsubstantiated and risks damaging your professional reputation. In healthcare and laboratory administration, all-female panels are common and not inherently indicative of bias. Furthermore, for a department head position, hiring committees frequently prioritize formal management training and broad leadership experience over advanced academic credentials like a PhD. A two-week delay for written feedback is also standard administrative turnaround in hospital HR. Instead of challenging the panel's composition, follow up politely to request constructive feedback on how to strengthen your candidacy for future leadership roles.
